notes.title: Microcosmum 2 is already on Steam !!!
notes.content:
[h3]We are pleased to announce that Microcosmum 2 will be available on Steam soon![/h3]

Microcosmum 2 has become much larger. It has a constructor of organisms, the action of the game takes place on the global map in real time.
You will now build buildings, conquer territories and create your own organisms.
Microcosmum has become much larger, better, more beautiful and retained its style and deep atmosphere.

notes.title: Sky Of Destruction. Our new game!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We glad to present you upcoming release of our new game![/b][/h1]
https://youtu.be/r9cDB4KfL6Y
Sky of Destruction is a top-down shooter where the player controls the aircraft.
Before starting a mission, select a combination of three types of aircraft in your fleet, which will help you during the mission.
Your goal is to destroy the enemy aircraft carrier or buildings, breaking through the enemy air armada.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9531401/c1ee9d9e6598351da4289151bf45bf57adf4fce7.png[/img]

Switch between planes during the mission. If your plane was hit, it’s not the end of the game, the extermination of the enemy does not stop. But keep your aircraft carrier safe.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9531401/b3ae8ba218cc6339d97c8eed31dc927c97d6e7c2.png[/img]

Pump a lot of parameters of your aircraft with a large selection of items that you will receive with the successful completion of missions. Each aircraft has its own inventory of individual form.
Put items in the most effective way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9531401/2730996a2e1a9bfe0016d58700250c7b2aa971fd.png[/img]

Enjoy the juicy explosions of enemy buildings and their physical destruction.
Explosions and total destruction! 

[h1][b]Add to wishlist![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003880/Sky_Of_Destruction/

notes.title: Stellatum. Our new game!
notes.content:
[img]https://pp.userapi.com/c837237/v837237466/566cc/rDEbHxRsh3U.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EsE6SCBcFuk

[h1]We glad to present you upcoming release of our new game![/h1]

Stellatum is a new exciting scroll shooter.

Setup your battle ship with guns, install faster engine and reactor that is more powerful. And throw a barrage of rockets on hordes of enemy ships, burning everything in your path.

Win opponents alone or with friends in a cooperative game of up to 4 players.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/691630/extras/2.png?t=1503306286[/img]

PLOT:
You are playing for an extraterrestrial race that has just become ready to conquer outer space.
Whole story begins with the fact that you are going to destroy a comet that threatens your planet. An unforeseen event happened that dragged you into the midst of the battles. But everything may not be what it seems.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/691630/extras/3.png?t=1503306286[/img]

Every element in the game was made with individual approach, polished to the smallest detail.
Excellent graphics drawing, visual effects, music and sound effects - all this is perfectly harmonized in its special style and atmosphere of the game.

Guns in game are represented not only by a variety of shooting methods, they are also essential parts of your ship, changing the look of your ship throughout the campaign. In each mission you will discover new weapons, engines and other items for your ship.

Main campaign includes 80 missions, divided into different locations, in which you will meet several different opponents races and strong bosses.

Super weapons are presented in the form of systems, they are divided into combat and support systems that are powered by the reactor you have installed.
Combat systems will incinerate your opponents, and support systems will support you and your partner in a multiplayer game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/691630/extras/4.png?t=1503306286[/img]
[list]
     [*]Excellent graphics
     [*]Ship designing
     [*]A lot of different guns
     [*]Many types of opponents
     [*]Multiple levels
     [*]Co-operative game for up to 4 players
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/691630/extras/5.png?t=1503306286[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/691630/Stellatum/

notes.title: Big Update 2.0
notes.content:
[img]https://pp.userapi.com/c625123/v625123722/3e9f1/_LRxGxHpUtc.jpg[/img]

[h1]We glad to present you new version of Microcosmum![/h1]
Changes were made almost to every part of game. Gameplay, visual, audio and tech are significantly improved.
Now every single level has unique landscape, that you may use for your advance.
Improved AI now has few difficulty levels. Choose one that suits most to your gameplay preferences: meditation or hardcore battle.
New visual effects and new soundtracks will bring you deeper to game atmosphere.


[h1] New content:	[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Unique landscape for each level.
    [*]Added decorations for levels.
    [*]Added new gameplay elements.
[/list]

[h1]Sound:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added new music and reworked old one.
    [*]Some old sound reworked and new added.
[/list]

[h1]Interface:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Game difficulty levels.
    [*]Screen resolution selection moved to options dialog.
    [*]New cursor added.
    [*]Added option to bind keyboard keys.
    [*]2 old level packages were transferred to 1.
    [*]Levels numeration added.
    [*]Interface animations and visual effects.
[/list]

[h1]Controls:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Several organisms selection.
    [*]Select all organisms at once.
    [*]Add organism to selection.
[/list]

[h1]Textures improved:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Neutral organisms
    [*]Levels background
    [*]Backgrounds particles
    [*]Organisms highlight
[/list]

Steam Cloud support added
Organisms trail
Organisms upgrade effect reworked
Command click effect added
Improved AI now more complicated
4 difficulty levels 
Levels background animated
Antibodies generation and organisms upgrades rebalanced
Rebalanced evolution system
Tutorial updated


[h1]Bugfix:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Camera scroll with mouse on screen side.
    [*]Organisms and antibodies selection.
    [*]Organisms and antibodies controls.
    [*]German localization fix.
[/list]
